native_sources.name: wp_verify_nonce()
native_sources.notes: Nonce verification is CSRF/request-intent protection, not authorization.

native_sources.name: REST API custom endpoints
native_sources.notes: REST mutations require an explicit permission_callback.

records.label: Field Registry Controls / Prefill
records.notes: Rich form controls/prefill are parity; reusable control schema remains Fields-owned.

records.label: Validation / Server-Authoritative Calculations
records.notes: Calculations/validation are parity while server validation remains authoritative.

records.label: Submission / Rate Limit / Duplicate Policy
records.notes: Submission restrictions are parity; nonce/session/capability checks never replace authorization and duplicate/rate policy remains explicit.

records.label: Canonical Action Owner / Ordering
records.notes: Ordered steps/actions are parity; targets remain registered canonical Abilities/providers.

records.label: Timeout / Retry / Failure / Compensation
records.notes: Providers expose failure states but portable timeout/retry/backoff/compensation guarantees remain explicit WPE reliability contracts.

records.label: Run State / Checkpoints / Resume / Cancel
records.notes: Workflow status/step lifecycle is market-evidenced; WPE normalizes deterministic run/checkpoint semantics.

records.label: Correlation / Replay Protection
records.notes: Correlation/idempotent replay protection remains a WPE-exceed reliability guarantee.

records.label: Payment Provider Mapping
records.notes: Payments are common integrations but execution/reconciliation remains provider-owned.

records.label: Registered Ability / Vault Secret Reference
records.notes: Workflow actions use registered Ability/provider references and Vault secret references only.

records.label: Raw Executable Workflow Input
records.notes: Market extensibility is not evidence to accept raw PHP/script/callback authored input.

records.label: Registered Admin-Post / AJAX / REST Invocation Channel
records.notes: Captures authenticated/public scope, REST route/method/schema and permission policy, nonce/session requirements and canonical target Ability. Raw hook names/callbacks remain forbidden.

coverage.notes: All Forms & Workflows records are native/market classified. Form, entry and workflow basics are parity; retry/replay/secret/action safety remain WPE hardening, payment execution stays provider-owned, and raw executable workflows stay rejected.
